single_variable.name: catchup_value_loss
single_variable.treatment: SmoothL1 beta=1.0 raw critic-v1 bb unit

decision.rationale: H9 ended before a valid control endpoint and before treatment launch, so it contains no evidence about the registered method. The H8/Route Review005 mechanism evidence remains the strongest frozen causal lead. A separately locked clean rerun from the same pre-H9 source is the smallest prospective action and avoids post-hoc method, source, gate or sample changes.
requirements: Create a separate immutable H10 preregistration; H9 remains terminal and closed.
Use fresh run directories and the exact H8 source for both arms; never use H9 partial latest.pt.
Keep fixed20M per arm, control-first order, beta1.0 and every H9 statistical gate unchanged.
Reuse validated trainer semantics only after a new H10 identity audit, design lock and preflight pass.
Harden reporting/control-plane isolation with an active-window sentinel and exact evaluator-process matching; this may not change trainer behavior or relax the no-evaluation rule.
No extension, second seed, later endpoint or official Slumbot hands in H10.
No concurrent delegated CardPilot task may inspect or execute evaluation planners while an H10 arm is active.
